## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the issue (for example, `Closes #123`).

## Verification

List the checks run and their results, including GUI or platform checks when relevant.

- [ ] Required CI passes.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog reflect user-visible changes.
- [ ] Project-file, CLI, and scientific behavior remain compatible, or changes are explicitly documented.

## Remaining work

Link any known limitations, dependent issues, or follow-up verification; write "None" if complete.
